title: BIOHEALTH SCIENCES CAPSTONE EXPERIENCE
description: Covers knowledge and professional skills that students will need to obtain and sustain a successful career in health-related professions. Explores career opportunities and learn how to successfully compete for jobs. Analyzes clinical research problem in BioHealth Sciences and communicate the results of this analysis.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: BHS 323* or MB 311* or ((MB 385* or BHS 345*) and (MB 302* or 302H*)).
* May be taken concurrently.
A minimum grade of D- is required in BHS 323, MB 311, MB 385, BHS 345, MB 302 and MB 302H.

Enrollment limited to students with a term class standing of Junior or Senior.

Enrollment is limited to students with a major in Microbiology (570) or BioHealth Sciences (606).
